Chapter 11
Acting in the Certain Way

Thought is the creative power. It's the driving force that makes creation happen. Thinking in a Certain Way will bring you wealth. But you can't just rely on thought alone. You also need to take personal action. Many otherwise scientific metaphysical thinkers fail right here. They don't connect their thoughts with personal action, and that's where they run into trouble.

We haven't reached a point yet where people can create things directly from the Formless Substance. Even if that stage is possible, we're not there. We still need nature's processes and human effort. So, you must not only think, but your personal actions must also support your thoughts.

Through thought, you can cause the gold deep within the mountains to be drawn toward you. But it won't mine itself. It won't refine itself. It won't turn itself into coins and roll down the roads right into your pocket.

With the driving power of the Supreme Spirit, people's lives will be arranged so that someone will be guided to mine that gold for you. Other people's business deals will be directed in such a way that the gold comes to you. You must also arrange your own business so you can properly receive it when it arrives. Your thoughts make everything, both living and non-living, work to bring you what you want. However, your personal actions must be set up so you can rightfully receive what you want when it gets to you. You shouldn't take it as charity or steal it. You must give everyone more in use value than they give you in cash value.

The scientific way to use thought involves three things: First, form a clear and distinct mental image of what you want. Second, firmly commit to your goal of getting what you want. Third, realize with grateful faith that you are getting what you want.
Don't try to
project
your thoughts in some mysterious or magical way. Don't think your thoughts will just go out and do things for you. That's a waste of effort. It will also weaken your ability to think clearly.

The way thought helps you get rich is fully explained in the previous chapters. Your faith and purpose clearly imprint your vision onto the Formless Substance. This Substance has the same desire for more life that you have. This vision, once received from you, activates all the creative forces. They work through their regular channels of action, but they are directed specifically toward you.
It's not your job to guide or supervise the creative process. All you need to do is hold onto your vision, stick to your purpose, and maintain your faith and gratitude.

But you must act in a Certain Way. This allows you to claim what is yours when it comes to you. It also ensures you can meet the things you've envisioned and put them in their proper places as they arrive.
You can easily see that this is true. When things reach you, they will be in the hands of other people. These people will ask for something in return.
And you can only get what is yours by giving the other person what is theirs.
Your wallet isn't going to magically turn into Fortunatus's purse, always full of money without any effort from you.

This is the crucial point in the science of getting rich: thought and personal action must be combined. Many people, whether they realize it or not, activate the creative forces through the strength and persistence of their desires. But they stay poor because they don't prepare to receive what they want when it arrives.
Through thought, what you want is brought to you. Through action, you receive it.

Whatever your action needs to be, it's clear that you must act now. You can't act in the past. For your mental vision to be clear, it's essential that you dismiss the past from your mind. You also can't act in the future, because the future isn't here yet. And you won't know how you'll want to act in any future situation until that situation actually happens.
Just because you're not in the right business or environment right now, don't think you have to postpone action. Don't wait until you get into the
right

business or environment. Also, don't spend time now trying to figure out the best course of action for possible future emergencies. Have faith in your ability to handle any emergency when it actually arrives.
If you act in the present but your mind is focused on the future, your current actions will be unfocused. They won't be effective.
Put your whole mind into what you're doing right now.
Don't give your creative impulse to the Original Substance and then just sit down and wait for results. If you do that, you'll never get them. Act now. There is only ever
now,
and there never will be any other time than
now.
If you're ever going to start preparing to receive what you want, you must begin now.
Whatever your action is, it will most likely involve your current business or job. It will also involve the people and things in your current environment.
You can't act where you aren't. You can't act where you've been. And you can't act where you're going to be. You can only act where you are.
Don't worry about whether yesterday's work was done well or poorly. Just do today's work well.
Don't try to do tomorrow's work today. There will be plenty of time for that when you get to it.
Don't try to use occult or mystical methods to influence people or things that are beyond your reach.
Don't wait for your environment to change before you act. Instead, create a change in your environment through your actions.
You can act on your current environment in such a way that you cause yourself to move into a better one.
Hold onto the vision of yourself in that better environment with faith and purpose. But act on your current environment with all your heart, all your strength, and all your mind.
Don't spend any time daydreaming or building castles in the air. Stick to your single vision of what you want, and act now.

Don't go looking for some brand new thing to do. Don't search for some strange, unusual, or remarkable action to perform as your first step toward getting rich. It's likely that your actions, at least for a while, will be the same ones you've been doing for some time. But you need to start performing these actions now in the Certain Way. That will surely make you rich.
If you are involved in a business and feel it's not the right fit for you, don't wait until you find the perfect business before you start acting.

Don't feel discouraged or sit around complaining that you're in the wrong place. No one is ever so stuck that they can't find the right place. And no one is ever so caught up in the wrong business that they can't transition to the right one.

Hold onto the vision of yourself in the right business. Have the purpose and faith that you will get into it—and that you are getting into it. But ACT within your current business. Use your current job as the stepping stone to a better one, and use your present environment as the means to move into a better one. If you hold onto your vision with faith and purpose, the Supreme Power will start moving the right opportunities toward you. And your action, when performed in the Certain Way, will move you toward those opportunities.
If you are an employee or wage earner and feel you need to change jobs to get what you want, don't just
project
your thoughts out into the universe, hoping it will get you another job. That approach will probably fail.
Instead, hold the vision of yourself in the job you want, while you ACT with faith and purpose in the job you currently have. Doing this will surely get you the job you want.

Your vision and faith will activate the creative force to bring the opportunity to you. At the same time, your actions will move the forces in your own environment to push you toward the place you want to be. In closing this chapter, let's add another statement to our core principles:
There is a thinking substance from which all things are made. In its original state, it permeates, penetrates, and fills the spaces of the universe.
A thought within this substance produces the very thing that the thought imagines.
A person can form things in their mind, and, by impressing those thoughts upon the formless substance, can cause the thing they think about to be created.

To do this, a person must shift from a competitive mindset to a creative one. They must form a clear mental picture of what they want. They must hold this picture in their thoughts with the fixed PURPOSE of getting it, and the unwavering FAITH that they are getting it. They must close their mind to anything that might shake their purpose, blur their vision, or weaken their faith.
So that they can receive what they want when it arrives, a person must act NOW on the people and things in their current environment.
